notes: Live package tracking: share a tracking number (Amazon, UPS, USPS, FedEx, DHL and more), allow Order tracking once, and Ervo checks the carrier for you, shows the latest scan on the card, and notifies you when it ships, is out for delivery and is delivered, even with Ervo closed

The Business Psyche speaks business: it's the company's working profile (what you offer, hours, policies, pricing, customers, tools, team) and the company's voice, not a personal profile; no banter or jokes are learned for a company

Drafts for customers, emails and texts: Ervo asks what happened before writing, never invents names, orders or credits, signs with your name (and company), and learns from the edits you make with the new Edit draft button
One Plans sheet: everyone is on Free for now with the other plans marked coming soon; only the owner's personal account can try a plan
Settings: the Switch row is centered with a new icon and breathing room under the Ervo card; pop-up sheets no longer scroll or drag the page unless they need to
highlights: Live package tracking with notifications at every step
Business Psyche is now the company's profile and voice
Drafts ask what happened first, end with your name, and learn from your edits
